realm_description: The coastline where continents first meet the wider world. Every citizen's story starts here, pulled outward by trade, curiosity, and the promise of connection.

primary.label: Diplomat
primary.description: Builds consensus, dreads open conflict more than slow progress.
primary.guiding_promise: I build bridges where others build walls.
primary.shadow_description: Smooths over a rupture that needed to be named, and calls the silence peace.

secondary.label: Philosopher
secondary.description: Chases understanding for its own sake, deeper than any single answer.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will not stop asking until the world reveals what it truly is.
secondary.shadow_description: Keeps asking the next question until the moment for an answer has already passed.

wheel.central_question: Should we build relationships, or seek new horizons?

growth.label: Philosopher
growth.description: Chases understanding for its own sake, deeper than any single answer.
growth.guiding_promise: I will not stop asking until the world reveals what it truly is.
growth.shadow_description: Keeps asking the next question until the moment for an answer has already passed.

other_ally.label: Architect
other_ally.description: Designs systems meant to outlast the person who built them.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I design what outlasts me — and that is enough.
other_ally.shadow_description: Falls in love with the design and forgets the people who have to live inside it.

quarter.label: Warden
quarter.description: Guards boundaries that others don't even know exist; constant, thankless watch.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will hold this line, long after everyone else has forgotten why it matters.
quarter.shadow_description: Stands watch so long they start seeing threats at a threshold nothing is actually crossing.

opposite.label: Navigator
opposite.description: Reads currents no one else notices; calculates the way through when the group panics.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will find the true course, even when the stars are hidden.
opposite.shadow_description: Trusts only their own reading of the current, and stops listening for anyone else's.

realmmate.label: Messenger
realmmate.description: Bridges people and truths that wouldn't otherwise connect.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I carry only what is real, to those who need it most.
realmmate.shadow_description: Carries everyone else's message so faithfully that their own voice goes quiet.

wheel.compatible_text: Messenger · Scout — fellow travelers of The Shoreline.
